title: Gluing the ordered quotient-preserving standard twist comparison
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], $A(E)$ the canonical symmetric graded algebra [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], and $D$ any normalized TautologicalQuotient of $E$ [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data] on $P=\operatorname{Proj}_S A(E)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj], with structure map $p$. Fix $r\geq0$, an ordered isomorphism $b:\mathcal O_S^{r+1}\cong E$, and a scheme isomorphism $e:P\cong\mathbf P^r_S$ [def-nagata-relative-projective-space] over $S$ satisfying AffineFreeComparison r b e V on every affine V. Fix also an isomorphism $\theta:\mathbf P^r_S\cong\mathbb P(\{0,\ldots,r\};S)$ over $S$ whose projection to integral Proj on each affine chart satisfies IsIntegralProjComparison [lem-trf-free-projective-bundle-base-change-space]. Then there is an isomorphism $t:(\theta\circ e)^*\mathcal O(1)\cong D.line$, where pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback] and the standard twist is [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. For every ordered coordinate $i$, the morphism $p^*\iota_i$ followed by $p^*b$ and $D.quotient$ equals the pullback of the standard coordinateSection $T_i$ [def-sfb-projective-coordinate-section] followed by t, through the canonical unit pullback identifications. No new scheme comparison or polynomial algebra is asserted to exist by this statement. It includes r=0 and empty charts.

proof.text: Apply normalized line existence to obtain t together with its coordinate equalities after restriction above every affine base open. Apply the repaired coordinate local-to-global theorem to t and these equalities. The existential global comparison and its public statement remain unchanged.

theorem exists_ordered_twist_comparison (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (r : ℕ) (b : RelativeProjectiveSpace.freeModule S r ≅ E)
    (eRel : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj ≅
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r)
    (hRel : eRel.hom ≫ RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r =
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)
    (hAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens,
      ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V)
    (θ : RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r ≅ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S))
    (hθ : θ.hom ≫ (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S) ↘ S) =
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r)
    (hθAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens, RelativeProjectiveSpace.IsIntegralProjComparison
      S r V (RelativeProjectiveSpace.affineToIntegral S r θ V)) :
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).obj
        (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) S 1) ≅ D.line,
      ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)),
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
            (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ b.hom) ≫ D.quotient =
        ((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison
            (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).app
              (Scheme.Modules.unit S) ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso
            (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).app
            (Scheme.Modules.unit _) ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).map
          (ProjectiveSpace.coordinateSection (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) S i) ≫ t.hom
